narrative: The technology sector is experiencing significant shifts with Apple appointing a new CEO, John Ternus, signaling a fresh leadership era. Innovations in AI continue to advance rapidly, with the Pentagon adopting advanced AI models and NVIDIA launching new, more efficient AI agent capabilities. Concurrently, cybersecurity threats are escalating, as evidenced by a surge in DDoS attacks, underscoring the critical need for enhanced digital defenses across all sectors.

highlights.title: John Ternus is now the CEO of Apple
highlights.whyItMatters: This marks a significant leadership change for one of the world's most valuable technology companies.

highlights.title: How engineered microbes could help feed the world’s crops
highlights.whyItMatters: This innovation offers a sustainable solution to critical global food supply challenges by reducing reliance on energy-intensive fertilizers.

highlights.title: Amazon EC2 R9g and R9gd instances powered by AWS Graviton5 processors are now generally available
highlights.whyItMatters: AWS continues to advance cloud infrastructure with new Graviton5 processors, offering enhanced performance for key workloads.

highlights.title: The Pentagon now has its own version of ChatGPT and Grok
highlights.whyItMatters: Major AI models are being adopted for national security, highlighting the growing integration of advanced AI in governmental sectors.

highlights.title: DoltLite: A SQLite fork with Git-style version control, built with 2k agent PRs
highlights.whyItMatters: This project introduces Git-style version control to SQLite, offering developers advanced capabilities for database management.

highlights.title: OpenAI supports California’s bill to advance youth AI safety
highlights.whyItMatters: This initiative reflects a growing focus on ethical AI development and responsible deployment, especially concerning younger users.

highlights.title: Cloudflare DDoS Threat Report H1 2026: 1 Tbps attacks soar as DNS floods and geopolitical tensions drive a new wave
highlights.whyItMatters: The significant increase in DDoS attacks highlights evolving cybersecurity threats and the need for robust infrastructure defenses.

highlights.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and NeMo Switchyard Deliver Faster, Smarter, More Efficient Agentic AI
highlights.whyItMatters: NVIDIA is enhancing AI agent capabilities with new models, improving efficiency and intelligence for complex AI workloads.
